subject.repo: @blockrun/nano-client 0.8.0 (npm exact pin) — Circle Gateway batched x402 dialect
subject.sut_note: SUT = published SDK (npm exact pin 0.8.0, unmodified); Argus = adversarial resource server of the Circle Gateway batched dialect (signer-oracle + server-side fixation). Canonical battery run: wave-4 commit 3a1608cc (2026-10-26T21:49:10Z, executed by a parallel session of this lab; suite self-reported 377/377 green, tsc clean). Independent lab-VM reproduction of the signing VM (worktree at 3a1608cc, 2026-10-27T07:43:33Z): tsc --noEmit exit 0 + vitest 377/377 PASS across 28 files (40.84s), SBS19 file 15/15 — verdicts identical, claim REPRODUCED. Source basis: closed issue BlockRunAI/blockrun-nano-client#15 (lab black-box loss-response/retry report, closed as not planned with an invitation to a production round) + source audit (index.ts:847/:439/:802-806/:562-564).
subject.lab_run_branch: main (wave 4); reproduction evidence committed on inngest/conformance-battery

scenarios.name: payto-substitution
scenarios.checks: 402 challenge carries the REAL verifyingContract (contract-pin material is genuine) but the attacker's payTo; the SDK's recipient check is shape-only ('valid non-zero address') and accepts the substituted recipient; signer-oracle capture shows the authorization signed over attacker payTo and dispatched — funds would route to the attacker while all on-shape validation passes

scenarios.name: overcharge-default
scenarios.checks: Default SDK configuration has no spend cap: the authorization is signed for x50 the requirements price. The cap (maxPaymentPerCall) is opt-in: P2-control confirms that when set, NanoPaymentRejectedError fires BEFORE the signer with 0 signer calls — the only amount guard, off by default

scenarios.name: lost-response-recovery
scenarios.checks: A lost-response error carries no recovery handles; getPaymentStatus is a dead-end (no client facts available to resume the lifecycle); the only remaining path — manual retry — mints a fresh nonce and produces a second economic execution. Contradicts the README claim 'a dropped connection cannot double-charge you'

scenarios.name: controls
scenarios.checks: C1 decimal-rejection: amount '0.5' rejected pre-signer (BigInt check), 0 signer calls. C2 contract-pin: substituted verifyingContract rejected pre-signer. C3 async-replay: 202-poll cycle consumes exactly 1 signature per lifecycle (same authorization replayed, no re-sign). Evaluator hygiene: PASS-canon requires controls 1-3 inside the verdict; missing controls, unobservable recovery, or an unserved probe escalate to HARNESS_ERROR
